definitionZh: 文本框 CSS 的短手属性对应文本框-trim和文本框-sedge属性,它们共同指定了从文本元素块容器的块启动边缘和块端边缘到剪切的空间.
sourceDefinition: The text-box CSS shorthand property corresponds to the text-box-trim and text-box-edge properties, which together specify the amount of space to trim from the block-start edge and block-end edge of a text element's block container.
